title: fix(templates): guard review lanes shed polluters, split pitofsuccess.errors, bound enroll lanes (the --mode hard drop is #418)
description:
# 🌙 dream: bhuild's guard templates use the reviewers the way this route learned to

- **kind** = `reseed`
- **owner** = `ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhuild` — `src/domain.operations/behavior/init/templates/*.guard`
- **caught** 2026-09-26, at stone `5.1.execution.from_vision` of `v2026_09_20.review-cost-meter`
- **status** = PLANNED — surfaced to the wisher before dispatch (seed S22)

## .the cue that fired

the wisher asked for a dispatch plan so bhuild's reviewer usage takes the repairs this route made.
every `5.1` / `5.3` guard bhuild stamps is the template this route's guard was cloned from, so
every new route inherits the lanes that overflowed here.

## .the gap, precisely — measured on this route, present verbatim in the templates

| # | what the template does today | what it cost here |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | production-rubric lanes bind `--paths-with '**/*.{ts,sh,md,snap}'` with no exclusions | `repo-rules` overflowed at 247 files, 82.3% of a 1M window; six lanes refused at i003 (607.2k tokens). `.behavior/**` alone was 25.5% of one corpus |
| 2 | `code.{prod,test}/pitofsuccess.errors` rides ONE lane | overflowed twice (76.0% / 77.2%); cured by a SPLIT into a prod lane and a test lane |
| 3 | level-3 `rhx enroll claude … -p '…'` lanes carry no scope, no read-only bound, no output contract | one timed out at 21 minutes over a ~500-file diff; one clone ran `route.stone.set` and marked the stone it reviewed `blocked` |
| 4 | every lane passes `--mode hard` | `--mode` is swallowed and ignored by the parser; `--focus push\|pull` replaced it |
| 5 | lanes on the default brain inherit whatever `--focus` a copy carries | deepseek flash is an atom brain; `--focus pull` is refused on it |

## .the shape of the fix — the task body to dispatch

1. **production-rubric lanes** add `--paths-without '**/*.test.ts' --paths-without '**/__snapshots__/**' --paths-without '.behavior/**'`
   - test-rubric lanes keep their `**/*.test.ts` include and shed only `__snapshots__` + `.behavior/**`
   - `friction-hazards` keeps `.behavior/**` minus `.fulcrums/**` + `.seeds/**` (it grades the route's prose)
2. **split** `code.{prod,test}/pitofsuccess.errors` into two lanes, prod-bound and test-bound
3. **enroll prompts** append: scope to `the files listed in $targets` (narrowed by prose to
   `src/`, `blackbox/` as the lane needs) and derive no scope of their own — `$targets` is a
   bhrain runtime guard var that holds the engine's since-main list, untracked files included
   (a diff-only prompt missed most of a mostly-untracked feature); READ-ONLY, never run
   `route.stone.set` or any `route.*` command; end with an `N blockers` line and an `N nitpicks`
   line (`contract.reviewer-output`)
   - 🟡 needs a bhrain release that carries `$targets` before bhuild's templates can name it
   - 🔴 the prompt alone does NOT stop a clone from `route.stone.set` (measured i003). pair it with
     the marker + refusal in `.dream/v2026_09_26.fix.an-enrolled-reviewer-clone-sets-…`, and fix
     the enroll settings' `Write(...)` deny rules, which Claude Code ignores
4. **drop `--mode hard`** from every lane
5. no lane on a flash brain passes `--focus pull`; a model pin in an enroll lane
   (`claude-sonnet-5[1m]`) is reviewed against `rule.require.versionless-brain-defaults`
6. a template snapshot test that fails when a production lane lacks the three exclusions

## .why it is not done in this round

it belongs to another repo; a tree adopts only what is scoped to itself. the plan waits on the
wisher's read before `rhx radio.task.push --via gh.issues --into ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhuild`.
